static_traits.name: Chen Kai
static_traits.family_status: 有两个兄弟姐妹，养了一只狗
static_traits.social_status: 与两位兄弟姐妹可交流，但尚not yet就此问题与他们沟通；其余社交情况Not disclosed
static_traits.medical_history: without心理治疗史，No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear thinking and expression, able to concretely describe events and feelings; relatively high cooperation; obvious tendencies toward catastrophizing, overgeneralization, black-and-white thinking, and jumping to conclusions

basic_info.main_problem: 由于狗在家中发生意外，我持续感到强烈的挫败与despair，并相信它永远without法完成如厕训练。
basic_info.core_demands: 当挫败与despair开始影响整体福祉和日常生活时，我决定寻求咨询。

core_beliefs: I am incompetent/not适合养狗的人

special_situations.event: 狗今天在地毯上发生意外
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果一次训练中出现意外，就说明训练失败、我not称职
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Intensifying the use of various training methods and cleaning procedures, and trying stricter routines

special_situations.event: 忙碌或分心导致not yet按时带狗外出，随后出现室内意外
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能完全控制所有变量，一旦出错就证明我失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 对自己加以苛责与negate，同时设定更多提醒并Reinforcement日程以避免再出错
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It is all my fault，我就是not称职

special_situations.event: Within one week there were both indoor accidents and successful outdoor toileting
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 负面事件更重要，正面进步not算数
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores successes, focuses on the negative, and loudly scolds after accidents, then feels guilt
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这些小成功根本not算，我永远都在收拾烂摊子

special_situations.event: After every indoor accident, immediately draws a negative conclusion about training as a whole
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一次挫败意味着永远失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Magnifies negative conclusions, questions whether one should keep a dog
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他永远not会被如厕训练好

core_conflict.wish: Longs to become a competent dog owner in control, and to be affirmed as capable
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被证实without能与失败，担心失去掌控并因此后悔养狗
defense_goal: 通过严格控制日程与加倍训练来防止失败；通过Self-denial保持警惕以避免再次出错

object_relations.self_representation: not称职、容易失败的训练者
object_relations.object_representation: A trainee (dog) that is hard to control and frequently causes trouble

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当狗在家里发生意外时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Immediately equates one accident with permanent training failure, and attributes the failure to myself
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: useSelf-denial的语句，语气低沉，反复强调“It is all my fault”。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor guides him to focus on positive progress or suggests recording successes
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为正面证据not重要或not足以改变结论，继续坚持负面判断
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 提供看似理性的解释来negate正面证据，use冷静但坚决的语气强调“这些成功not代表什么”。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当日程被打乱、without法按时带狗外出导致意外
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将not可控的外部干扰视为灾难，并把情绪Displacement到狗身上
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Raises his voice to scold the dog, emotionally intense; then expresses guilt and self-blame.

manifestations: 感到训练看not到希望、质疑自己是否适合养狗、正面进步被负面事件掩盖
outcomes: 日常作息与清洁习惯受影响

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 将训练中的失误全面归因于自身
难以接纳小的成功与进步

exception_events.target_problem: 在狗于家中发生意外时，来访者通常会灾难化并跳到结论，产生强烈挫败和despair，导致一天的心情与日程被破坏
exception_events.unique_outcome: While keeping to a strict routine (setting reminders and taking the dog out on time), the dog did its toileting outdoors, the client gave timely rewards and praise, the mood was relatively stable, and stress was clearly lower
exception_events.reason: not同做法：设定提醒并执行更一致的外出时间；not同支持：use正向Reinforcement（奖励与表扬）；not同情境：节奏更可控、意外更少

positive_force: Willing to try various training methods and cleaning routines
Able to maintain and benefit from a stricter schedule (self-management ability)
Has two siblings who can be potential support resources
Willing to conduct reality testing and record small successes, trying to adjust cognition
negative_force: 灾难化与跳到结论的思维倾向
High stress; tends to ignore positive evidence (focuses only on the negative)

target_behavior.behavior: When the dog has an indoor accident, shows intense anger and self-blame and shouts loudly
antecedent: 早晨刚起床尚not yet开始日常流程时发现脏乱
分心或忙碌导致not yet按时带狗外出
看到需要清理的污渍与气味
target_behavior.core_reason: 将一次意外灾难化并过度概括为训练永久失败，进而将失败归因于自我without能
target_behavior.function: 释放内在紧张与Anxiety以获得短暂的控制感，并回避without助与失败感
target_behavior.consequence: 加剧压力与despair，破坏一天的心情与日常作息，负面互动not利于训练成效
